findings.description: The bucket is documented and configured to be publicly accessible with no bucket policy, ACL restriction, or public access block configured, allowing unauthenticated read/write access to its contents.

No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest, and combined with the bucket's public exposure this significantly increases the risk of sensitive data disclosure.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data exposed in insecure storage
findings.description: A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded into the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, exposing sensitive customer data to unauthenticated access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored objects unencrypted at rest.
